insurance_bonds.text: Elevation: To mitigate potential flooding risks, all storage containers must be elevated to provide a minimum clearance of six (6) inches from the installation pad. • Security: Ensure all four (4) storage containers are fully lockable with padlocks, secure, and structurally sound to protect the enclosed government property from unauthorized access and environmental elements. • Government will supply and maintain padlocks. • Safety and PPE: Ensure contractor personnel utilize appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), including respiratory protection (e.g., N95 masks) if entering the storage containers for maintenance, as a precautionary safety measure. • Lighting: Lighting shall be installed within the container or there shall be 20amp 120v service receptacles for government furnished lighting. • Wear & Tear / Liability: The Government shall not be liable for normal wear and tear to the leased containers. 0126Q0135 Page 24 of 24 ===== FILE: files/ATTACHMENT_2_Performance_Work_Statement_Artwork_Storage_at_WPAFB_8.18.26.pdf ===== PERFORMANCE WORK STATEMENT (PWS) National Museum of the United States Air Force (NMUSAF) Artwork Storage at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base (WPAFB) 18 August 2026 1. BACKGROUND The Department of the Air Force Art Collection is comprised of over 9,000 paintings, works on paper, mixed media, textiles, and sculptures spanning from World War I to the present day. To ensure the long-term preservation and security of a specific portion of this historic collection, the NMUSAF requires temporary, climate- controlled on-site storage for 992 designated artworks at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base (WPAFB). Due to inadequate historical storage conditions at their previous location, all 992 of these specific artworks have experienced prior mold damage. To mitigate risk and contain the issue, all assets will be securely wrapped and packaged in protective materials prior to being placed into the storage containers, preventing any further spread of mold. Maintaining strict, continuous environmental controls within the storage containers is critical to arrest any active mold growth and protect the collection from further deterioration. 2.
